about: 60 example messages for the scam scorecard: 30 scams and 30 genuine. Written from common real-world patterns (UK and US). Phone numbers are reserved fictional numbers (07700 900xxx, 555-01xx); scam links use made-up addresses. Replace or extend with real examples you collect, with personal details removed.
